text: The added help entry uses beta or NIGHTLY_BUILD in both main/menu panel and routes via existing openLinkText. Review rejected developer-edition and ESR-based proxies because monthly releases and distribution builds could differ. Keep generic help plus channel help grouped. Current code still uses those predicates; no build/channel matrix run by the study.
title: Select channel-specific help through explicit accepted channel predicates
